== Free Pascal Binding with C/C++ 程序语言绑定


.函数调用约定 (Calling Convention) 
****
NOTE: 在编程中，函数调用约定 (Calling Convention) 规定了函数调用时参数传递、栈内存 (stack) 管理和返回值处理的规则。在汇编语言角度来看，每个函数过程的调用，需要先使用 push 指令将函数参数放到程序的栈内存 (stack) ，然后在执行 jump 指令跳转到函数的起始地址。函数返回时，则需要根据调用约定选择处理或不处理栈内存。C/C++ 标准调用 (cdecl) ，不需要被调用的函数来处理栈内存，因此，编译器在生成这类函数时就不会添加相应的栈清理指令。不同的调用约定会影响二进制兼容性，尤其在跨语言（如 Pascal/C) 或跨平台调用时至关重要。以下是主要调用约定的对比及在 Free Pascal (FPC) 中的实现方式：

[cols="2,2,2,4,2"]
|===
|Convention |参数传递处理顺序	|栈清理方	|适用场景	|FPC 关键字

|stdcall    |左⇚右	|被调方	|Windows API、COM 组件	|stdcall
|cdecl      |左⇚右	|调用方	|C 语言、可变参数函数	|cdecl
|pascal     |左⇛右	|被调方	|传统 Delphi/Pascal 语言 	|pascal
|safecall   |左⇚右	|被调方	|COM 方法（自动异常处理）	|safecall
|register   |寄存器+栈	|被调方	|Delphi 默认（非外部函数）	|register
|===

设置正确的参数调用处理方式的目的包括以下常见的几点：

•	API Compatibility: Most Win32 APIs use stdcall (callee cleans the stack).
•	Interoperability: Required when calling DLLs written in C/C++ that use __stdcall.
•	Stack Management: Ensures correct stack cleanup after function calls.

不同语言使用不同的语法来约定函数调用方式：

[cols="2,2,7"]
|===
|GCC Syntax	|Free Pascal Equivalent	|Purpose

|__attribute__((stdcall))	|stdcall	|Enforces stdcall convention
|__attribute__((cdecl))	|cdecl	|Enforces C-style calling convention
|__attribute__((pascal))	|pascal	|Enforces Pascal convention (rare)
|===

Free Pascal 中约定函数调用方式的参考代码片段：

[source,pascal]
----
// (a) For Functions/Procedures
// Use the stdcall modifier in the function declaration:
function MyStdCallFunction(param1: Integer; param2: Pointer): Integer; stdcall;
begin
  Result := param1 + 1;
end;

// (b) For External DLL Imports
// When declaring external functions (e.g., from Windows API), specify stdcall:
function MessageBoxA(hWnd: THandle; lpText, lpCaption: PChar; uType: UINT): Integer; 
  stdcall; external 'user32.dll';
----
****


Free Pascal (fpc.exe) 可以与 C/C++ 编写的静态库进行链接 (Binding) ，基本步骤：

•	准备 C/C++ 静态库，确保你有 .a (Unix-like) 或 .lib (Windows) 格式的静态库文件。
•	编写函数库使用 external "C" {} 包含 C/{CPP} 函数声明，避免 {CPP} 名称修饰 (name mangling)。
•	编译时链接库时使用 fpc -k-lyour_lib 命令行参数或者 {$LINKLIB} 指定要链接的静态库。

因为 {CPP} 引入了面向对象编程，对函数、方法的重载需要在技术上对其进行改名处理。Free Pascal（FPC）中链接 {CPP} 库函数需要解决 命名修饰（Name Mangling）和 调用约定 问题。若需调用 {CPP} 类方法，还需要在 Free Pascal 中重新包装函数以 Pascal 对象的形式暴露接口。函数 Name Mangling 处理可以使用 {CPP} 提供的  extern "C" 禁止修饰行为，保持函数名称不变。复杂项目可以考虑使用工具，比如 https://www.swig.org/[SWIG - Simplified Wrapper and Interface Generator]。


以下例子展示了如何在 Free Pascal 中调用 C 语言标准函数库。Linux 系统下需要链接 libc.a 静态库，Windows 系统下需要使用 MSVC 提供的 C 语言标准库实现，也就是 msvcrt.dll 动态链接库（Windows 系统自带）。因为有平台差异，必须使用预处理指令来进行条件编译。以下这种 $IFDEF/$ELSE/$ENDIF 宏指令同行的书写格式可以正常通过编译。

NOTE: Windows 系统上使用 https://packages.msys2.org/basegroups/mingw-w64-toolchain[MSYS2] 子系统也是一个选择，它提供了多个 C 语言标准函数库实现，可以在 Toolchain 依赖包分组中的后缀名为 crt-git 的依赖包中找到 libucrt.a 文件。比如 UCRT64 和 Clang64，那么对应的 C 语言标准库文件分别就是 ucrt64\lib\libucrt.a 和 clang64\lib\libucrt.a。为了让 FPC 编译器找到静态链接库，可以使用 {$LINKLIB} 编译器指令，或者命令行参数指定搜索路径。FPC 编译器会根据系统类型以及 _external_ 指定的库名称自动选择动态链接库类型 (dll 或 .so)。进行静态链接时，就需要使用 {$LINKLIB} 或命令行参数指定静态库，这时就不需要给 _external_ 关键字填写函数库的名称。可以在 {$LINKLIB} 指令中填写完整的路径，或者只填写库名称，再结合 {$LIBRARYPATH} 指令或者 -Fl 命令行参数来设置路径。

[source,pascal]
----
program testaocc;

{$mode objfpc}
// {$LINKLIB 'C:\msys64\ucrt64\lib\libucrt.a'}
// {$LINKLIB 'ucrt'}
// {$LIBRARYPATH 'C:\\msys64\\ucrt64\\lib'} 

Const
  P : Pchar
    = 'example';
  F : Pchar
    = 'This %s uses printf to print numbers (%d) and strings.'#10;

//procedure printf(fm: pchar);cdecl;varargs;external 'c';
procedure printf(fm: pchar;args: array of const);cdecl;
{$IFDEF WINDOWS} external 'msvcrt.dll'; {$ELSE} external 'c';{$ENDIF}

begin
 printf(F,[P,123]);
end.
----

编译编译得到的程序无非是 ELF (Linux) 或者 PE (Windows)，在编译源代码后、链接之前，这中间临时保存的文件是目标代码文件，它们已经从源代码文本编译得到对应目标机器上可以执行的代码，只是缺少整个程序的有机组织结构，还需要经链接程序 (link) 将所有目标文件链接到一起后才能执行。

静态库（在 Linux/Unix 上为 .a 文件，Windows 上为 .lib 文件）是多个目标文件的集合，可以按静态链接的方式使用，这样链接的程序运行时就不需要额外的动态链接库 (dll 或 .so) 。GCC 提供 ar 命令来创建静态库，也就目标文件的统一归档。MSVC 编译的 .lib 格式可以用 ranlib 工具转换成 .a 格式的静态库。完成静态链接后，可以检查真实依赖：Windows: 使用 dumpbin /DEPENDENTS your_program.exe，Linux: 使用 ldd your_program。使用 ar -t your_lib 可以查看静态库中包含的目标代码文件。

.常见目标文件格式
[cols="2,7"]
|===
|   ELF	|Executable and Linkable Format 是 Linux/Unix 主流格式 (LLVM 支持），Section 结构：.text(代码)、.data(初始化数据)、.bss(未初始化数据)、.symtab(符号表)。Segment 结构：程序头表描述运行时内存布局。变种：.o (可重定位)、.so (动态库)、可执行文件。
|  COFF	|Common Object File Format 是 Unix System V 的早期格式，Windows PE 格式的前身。分段结构与 ELF 类似，但扩展性较差。
|Mach-O	|Mach Object 是 macOS/iOS 系统格式，支持多架构 fat binary（通用二进制）。
|    PE	|Portable Executable 是 Windows 系统格式，包含 DOS stub + PE header + sections (.text, .rdata, .idata等)。
|a.out	|早期 Unix 格式，现已被 ELF 取代。
|   OMF	|Relocatable Object Module Format，DOS/Windows 的旧格式 (Turbo C 等使用）。
|===

DOS 时代开始，Borland 公司的产品就开始支持 Relocatable Object Module Format (OMF) 格式，C++Builder's Win32 compiler (bcc32) 支持编译这种格式，Delphi's Win32 编译器支持链接这种格式。Borland 公司提供的相应的分析工具 tdump，安装 Delphi 7 就可以获得。

Common Object File Format (COFF) 也是较流行的一种格式，Unix System V 系统就开始使用，Microsoft's Visual C++ 编译器也支持，当然 Delphi Win32/Win64 编译器也没有缺席（最新版本已经归属 Embarcadero 公司）。MSVC 工具包中提供了专用的 dumpbin 工具来分析 COFF 目标文件。

Executable and Linkable Format (ELF) 是当下 Unix/Linux 系统标准目标文件格式（可执行文件格式），使用 readelf 工具分析，可以使用 objdump 进行反汇编，还可以使用 nm 进行符号分析 (pass:[C++] 符号可 demangle) 。LLVM 编译器基础架构提供支持，因此基于 LLVM 编译器工具链的 Delphi 或 C++Builder 编译器也支持。Win64 的 {CPP}Builder 编译器 (bcc64) 使用了 LLVM 基础设施，因此生成的目标文件是 ELF 格式的。但是，最新版本的 Delphi 编译器不支持 ELF 这种格式。

高级逆向分析工具参考：

•	Ghidra：美国国家安全局 (NSA) 创建和维护的软件逆向工程 (SRE) 框架 ，支持反编译、图形化分析。
•	IDA Pro：商业逆向工程标杆，支持多架构深度分析。
•	Radare2：开源逆向框架，支持脚本化分析。
•	OllyDbg：Oleh Yuschuk 开发的一款 x86 调试器，用于进行二进制代码分析，已停止维护。

静态库 (Static Library) 就是包含目标代码的文件，和使用 gcc -c 生成的目标代码文件没有本质区别，可以将静态库看作是多个目标文件的归档文件。而静态链接，函数库的代码最终会和输出的程序链接到统一个二进制可执行文件中，这样就不要到处找依赖的动态链接库文件。与动态链接库的不同在于，动态库的代码保存在 DLL/SO 文件，需要在程序运行时动态加载，这就需要告知系统，所依赖的动态库文件在什么位置，比如将动态库的所在目录导出到环境变量，export LD_LIBRARY_PATH/PATH。

Use the ar (archiver) command to bundle the object files into a static library:
ar rcs libmylib.a lib1.o lib2.o

.ar (archiver) 命令常用参数
[cols="2,7"]
|===
|-r	|Replace or add files. 将目标代码文件插入静态库尾或者替换静态库中同名文件。
|-x	|从静态库文件中抽取文件目标代码文件。
|-t	|打印静态库的成员文件列表。
|-d	|从静态库中删除文件目标代码文件。
|-s	|Write an index for faster access. 编写文件索引以加速访问。
|-v	|显示详细信息。
|-c	|创建静态库文件（目标代码文件打包）。
|===


https://downloads.freepascal.org/fpc/docs-pdf/user.pdf[User’s Guide for Free Pascal, 6.11.5 Linker options (Version 3.2.2)]
• https://downloads.freepascal.org/fpc/docs-pdf/prog.pdf[Programmer's guide Chapter 7 Linking issues]
• https://lists.freepascal.org/fpc-pascal/2024-February/062212.html[Can FPC link a program with static (.a) libraries on Windows]
• https://www.pcjs.org/software/pcx86/lang/borland/pascal/6.00/[Turbo Pasca/® Version 6.0 Programmer's Guide - 23 Linking assembler code ]
• Delphi high performance (Primož Gabrijelčič) 8 Using External Libraries

Hence the question, does FPC 3.2.2 support linking with static libraries 
on windows?"external <libname> name <funcname>" is for dynamic linking. For static linking you need to leave out the <libname> and instead use "{$linklib <libname>}" or even "{$linklib <libname>, static}" . That will also work on Linux. Regards, Sven 

Free Pascal 代码文件中使用 "external <libname> name <function name>" 来声明动态库函数。静态链接库的正确方法是：省略外部函数声明中的 <libname> 参数，改用编译指令 {$linklib <libname>} 或更明确的 {$linklib <libname>, static}。Free Pascal 编译器 (fpc.exe) 命令行选项 -XS 用于指定链接器行为，这个选项等效于定义了一个 FPC_LINK_STATIC 符号，告诉 Free Pascal 编译器使用静态链接方式。

The external directive tells the compiler that the function resides in an external block of code. You canusethis together with the {$L} or {$LinkLib} directives to link to a function or procedure in a library or external object file. Object files are looked for in the object search path (set by -Fo) and libraries are searched for in the linker path (set by -Fl).

在尝试掌握 Free Pascal 静态链接功能的过程中，官方的 Programmer’s Guide for Free Pascal 文档反而没有起到太大的作用，它阐述了如何使用外部的变量、函数，当时在讲解静态链接的时使用了  7.1.4 Declaring the external object code 这样的小标题，这可能导致读者不能很好地与静态编译行为连接起来。我想这种隐晦表达的存在，是文档作者的一种“失职”。文档内容还是说明了智能链接功能 {$SMARTLINK ON}，激活它可以按更小粒度来组织代码，程序运行时只需要加载需要的部分，使得程序响应速度更快。

	External Directive (Delphi in a Nutshell , Ray Lischner)
	Syntax
	subroutine declaration; external;
	subroutine declaration; external DllName;
	subroutine declaration; external DllName name String;
	subroutine declaration; external DllName index Constant;

	Link object file (Delphi Compiler Options and Directives)
	$Link Compiler Directive
	Syntax
	{$L FileName}
	{$Link FileName}

Free Pascal 常用编译选项：

[cols="2,7"]
|===
|FPC Options	|Description

|-Xs	|Strip all symbols from executable
|-XS	|Try to link units statically (default, defines FPC_LINK_STATIC)
|-XD	|This will define the symbol FPC_LINK_DYNAMIC
|-Xt	|Link with static libraries (-static is passed to linker)
| -k	|向链接程序传递参数，比如 -k-l<libname> 指定链接特定库。
|-Fl<path>	|添加库搜索路径。
|-FD<path>	|添加链接器搜索路径。
|-FEbin	|指定二进制文件输出目录为 bin 目录，必须已经创建该目录。
|-omy.exe	|指定二进制程序文件名称为 my.exe，（输出目录为 bin 目录）。
|===

需要注意以下问题：

•	静态库的扩展名必须是 .a 。如果是其他扩展名，fpc 会将其视作 DLL 动态链接库，导致链接失败；
•	若静态库文件名为 libxyz.a，链接时可写作 {$LinkLib xyz}，能省略 lib 前缀和 .a 扩展名；
•	如果是 MSVC 编译的静态库，需要使用 ranlib 命令直接转化 .lib 为 .a 格式；
•	fpc 支持 gcc 编译器生成的静态库，但是不支持 clang 编译器生成的静态库，似乎是 COFF 格式有问题。


fpc 所使用的链接工具和 gcc 的一样，是由 GNU Binutils 提供的 ld，而 clang 使用的链接工具是 LLVM 提供的 lld。不过 gcc 是可以链接 clang 编译的静态库的，也许可以手动使用 ar 命令将 clang 编译生成的 .o 文件封装成 .a 静态库。

FPC 编译器链接选项 (Options—Linker) 提供了一组选项来定义代码单元的链接方式，Preferred library type 分组中包含以下选项：

•	(-XD) Dynamic libraries -- Tries to link in units in dynamic libraries.
•	(-XS) Static libraries -- Tries to link in units in static libraries.
•	(-XX) Smart libraries -- Tries to link in units in smart-linked libraries.


以下是一个简单的 mathlib.c 测试函数库，为了简化操作，这里不使用头文件，也不使用 C++ 的 extern "c" {} 保护代码块。目的是提供一个基于 make 构建脚本组织的小型工程，使用 make test 命令进行编译、测试：

.hi_binding\mathlib.c
[source,cpp]
----
// mathlib.c
__attribute__((cdecl)) int square(int x) {
    return x * x;
}
----


.hi_binding\main.pas
[source,pascal]
----
// main.pas
program Main;

// Static link with external API
{$LinkLib 'mathlib', static}
function square_static(x: Integer): Integer; cdecl; external name 'square';

// Dynamic link with external API
function square_dynamic(x: Integer): Integer; cdecl; external 'mathlib' name 'square';

begin
  Writeln('Square of 4 = ', square_static(4));
end.
----


.hi_binding\makefile
[source,makefile]
----
# Disable all built-in implicit rules
MAKEFLAGS += --no-builtin-rules

all: mains.exe maind.exe

maind.exe : mathlib.o main.pas
	gcc -shared -o mathlib.dll mathlib.o
	fpc main.pas -k-lmathlib -k-L. -omaind.exe

mains.exe : mathlib.o main.pas
	ar  rcs  libmathlib.a   mathlib.o
	fpc -Xt -XS  main.pas -k-lmathlib.o -k-L. -FE. -omains.exe

mathlib.o : mathlib.c
	gcc -c -o mathlib.o mathlib.c

clean:
	rm -f  *.o *.dll *.exe *.a

test: mains.exe
	fpc -h | grep "Compiler version" 2>&1
	gcc --version
	ldd ./mains.exe
	./mains.exe
----


== SDL3 binding with Free Pascal 

TIP: 此教程基于 Windows + MSYS2 系统，GNU make 自动化构建工具和 Free Pascal 编译器命令进行开发 。无需使用 IDE 环境，但是推荐使用 Vim，它集成了调用 make 命令的功能，并且可以检测编译器输出信息。但是可以直接安装 Lazarus IDE 以同时获取 IDE 工具和 FPC 编译器。建议作为便利工具包用途，安装 MSYS2 平台，并且安装 GCC 编译器套件，它可以提供 ldd （查看动态链接库信息）这类开发工具，并且还有 bash 脚本编程的支持。



SDL (Simple DirectMedia Layer) 是一个优秀的图形开发框架，最新版本升级到了 SDL 3.0，这是一个 {CPP} 实现的跨平台多媒体编程框架项目，通过 Free Pascal 提供的 C/C++ 调用支持，实现 SDL 的二进制绑定 (binding) ，可以非常方便地与 Free Pascal 结合，用于游戏或图形应用的开发。比如现在已经停止更新的 SwinGame 游戏开发框架就使用到 SDL。

•	https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases[SDL 3.0]
•	https://libsdl.org/[Simple DirectMedia Layer]
•	https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/FrontPage[Simple DirectMedia Layer 3.0 wiki]
•	https://github.com/PascalGameDevelopment/SDL3-for-Pascal[Pascal Units for SDL3]
•	https://github.com/PascalGameDevelopment/SDL2-for-Pascal[Pascal Units for SDL2]
•	https://www.freepascal-meets-sdl.net/sdl-tutorials/[SDL3 Tutorial]
•	https://wiki.freepascal.org/Creating_bindings_for_C_libraries[Creating bindings for C libraries]
•	https://downloads.freepascal.org/fpc/docs-pdf/CinFreePascal.pdf[G. Marcou, E. Engler, A. Varnek, How to use C code in Free Pascal projects]

.Table 2.1 SDL Subsystems (Focus On SDL: The Premier Press Game Development Series) 
[cols="2,2,7"]
|===
|Subsystem	|Description	|DirectX Equivalent

|Video	 |Encapsulates the video display	|DirectDraw
|Event	|Handling Encapsulates event handling	|DirectInput
|Joystick	|Encapsulates using joysticks	|DirectInput
|Audio	|Encapsulates working with audio hardware	|DirectSound
|CD-ROM	|Streams music from a normal CD	|N/A
|Threads	|Multi-threading helper functions	|N/A
|Timers	|Timing helper functions	|N/A
|===

SDL 的作者 Sam Lantinga 在游戏界相当出名，他是 Loki 娱乐软件公司的首席软件工程师和共同创始人。该公司曾将多款热门游戏移植到 Linux 平台，推动了 Linux 游戏领域的发展。Lantinga 于 1998 年在该公司工作时发布了 SDL，并首先利用 SDL 将游戏《毁灭战士》移植到 BeOS 操作系统。由于硬件体系结构都是标准化生产的，Lantinga 通过 API 规范将这些在系统接口差异巨大的标准化的硬件统一起来，形成了 SDL 开发框架。Lantinga 开始着手开发这样的跨平台工具，经过一年多的努力完成了第一个稳定的 SDL 发行版。通过 SDL 框架，他在短短三天时间内将 DOOM 移植到三个不同的平台上，并顺畅运行。2012 年7月 Lantinga 发布 SDL 2.0，这是一个重大更新，与之前的 SDL 1.2 有很多不同，API 不能向后兼容。新增功能包括：多视窗的支持，2D 图形硬件加速，以及更好的 Unicode 字符集支持，并且会提供更好的 Android 支持。

.SDL vs. SFML (Simple and Fast Multimedia Library)
[cols="2,4,5"]
|===
|特性	|SDL	|SFML

|图形渲染	|基础 2D（需结合 OpenGL 实现高级效果）	|内置 2D 渲染（精灵、纹理、视图系统）1
|音频	|基础播放功能	|高级音频流、空间化音效支持4
|输入处理	|直接访问键盘/鼠标/手柄	|事件驱动模型（如 sf::Event) 8
|网络	|需第三方库（如 SDL_net) 	|内置 TCP/UDP 模块1
|多窗口	|支持有限（需手动管理）	|原生多窗口支持 (SFML 3.0+）9
|===

SDL 和 SFML 都是轻量级框架：SDL 优先跨平台兼容性、底层控制、C/OpenGL 整合需求；SFML 优先快速开发、pass:[C++] 项目、2D 游戏/图形应用。Spine 是一个专业的 2D 动画制作商业软件，SFML 可以和 Spine 动画制作结合，开发出效果不错的 2D 动画系统。因为是 pass:[C++] 开发，SDL 也可以结合 Spine 动画系统提供的 API。开发者对 SDL 与 SFML 的评价与社区反馈：SDL 被赞为“行业标准”，尤其适合需要极致控制的开发者，缺点是 API 较原始，多窗口支持较弱；SFML 受到 pass:[C++] 开发者喜爱，易用性高，但早期版本因 Bug 被诟病，SFML 3.0 引入现代 pass:[C++] 特性（如移动语义、类型安全），显著提升可靠性。

.Migrating SDL 1.2 extensions (SDL Game Development)
[cols="2,7"]
|===
|     Name	| Description

|SDL_image	| This is an image file loading library with support for BMP, GIF, PNG, TGA, PCX, and among others.
|  SDL_net	| This is a cross-platform networking library.
|SDL_mixer	| This is an audio mixer library. It has support for MP3, MIDI, and OGG.
|  SDL_ttf	| This is a library supporting the use of TrueType fonts in SDL applications.
|  SDL_rtf	| This is a library to support the rendering of the Rich Text Format (RTF)
|===

SDL 为游戏提供多个模块，sdl2_gfx、sdl2_image、sdl2_mixer、sdl2_net、sdl2_ttf，全面满足图形、特性、音频、网络等基础功能的支持。SDL 官方默认提供动态链接库共调用，Free Pascal 可以很方便地通过 external 指令链接到 SDL 动态链接库。为了简化使用，可以使用现有的 SDL binding for Free Pascal。通过链接就可以下载到 SDL3-for-Pascal （目前还有部分模块没有完工）包含的绑定代码，位于 units 子目录中。调用 FPC 编译器时通过 -Fu../path/to/units 将用于绑定 SDL 的单元代码告知编译器。

根据使用的系统和 CPU 架构选择下载 SDL3 发布的二进制动态链接库：

•	Linux: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.2.18/SDL3-3.2.18.zip[SDL3-3.2.18.zip]
•	Windows 32 Bit: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.2.18/SDL3-3.2.18-win32-x86.zip[SDL3-3.2.18-win32-x86.zip]
•	Windows 64 Bit: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.2.18/SDL3-3.2.18-win32-x64.zip[SDL3-3.2.18-win32-x64.zip]
•	Windows ARM 64 Bit: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.2.18/SDL3-3.2.18-win32-arm64.zip[SDL3-3.2.18-win32-arm64.zip]
•	macOS: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.2.18/SDL3-3.2.18.dmg[SDL3-3.2.18.dmg]
•	Android: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.2.18/SDL3-devel-3.2.18-android.zip[SDL3-devel-3.2.18-android.zip]

Linux 系统直接下载源代码编译得到动态链接库。Windows 系统直接现在编译好的二进制动态链接库，并解包其中的 SDL3.dll 到项目构建时输出程序的目录中，比如 bin 子目录。也可以将其拷贝到系统环境变量 PATH 列表中的任何一个路径下，以供依赖 SDL3 的所有程序使用。其它组件根据需要下载：

•	https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_image/releases/download/release-3.2.4/SDL3_image-3.2.4-win32-x64.zip[SDL3_image-3.2.4-win32-x64.zip]
•	https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_ttf/releases/download/release-3.2.2/SDL3_ttf-3.2.2-win32-x64.zip[SDL3_ttf-3.2.2-win32-x64.zip]
•	https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_mixer/releases/download/release-2.8.1/SDL2_mixer-2.8.1-win32-x64.zip[SDL2_mixer-2.8.1-win32-x64.zip]
•	https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_net/releases/download/release-2.2.0/SDL2_net-2.2.0-win32-x64.zip[SDL2_net-2.2.0-win32-x64.zip]

SDL3 binding 单元作用就是为方便 Free Pascal 程序调用 SDL 函数库，建立 C/C++ 代码与 Pascal 代码的互调用环境，也就是通过动态链接库建立的 API 关系映射 (binding) 。其中的 SDL3.pas 作为单元接口，它负责设置不同系统细如何绑定具体的动态链接库文件：Windows 系统就绑定 SDL3.dll；Unix/Linux 系统就绑定 libSDL3.so 等等。设置好 SDL_LibName，然后通过编译器指令 {$I filename} {$INCLUDE filename} 包含各个 API 映射文件，比如 {$I SDL_init.inc}，建立动态库与 API 的关系映射。

有多种方式添加代码单元到 FPC 编译器中：

•	(FPC) using the {$UNITPATH        |XXX} directive in your source code;
•	(FPC) using the -FuXXX command-line argument to the compiler;
•	just copying & pasting the units into the same directory as your main source code.

.units/SDL3.pas
[source,makefile]
----
  {$IFDEF WINDOWS}
    SDL_LibName = 'SDL3.dll';
  {$ENDIF}

  {$IFDEF UNIX}
    {$IFDEF DARWIN}
      SDL_LibName = 'libSDL3.dylib';
      {$IFDEF FPC}
        {$LINKLIB libSDL2}
      {$ENDIF}
    {$ELSE}
      {$IFDEF FPC}
        SDL_LibName = 'libSDL3.so';
      {$ELSE}
        SDL_LibName = 'libSDL3.so.0';
      {$ENDIF}
    {$ENDIF}
  {$ENDIF}

  {$IFDEF MACOS}
    SDL_LibName = 'SDL3';
    {$IFDEF FPC}
      {$linklib libSDL3}
    {$ENDIF}
  {$ENDIF}
----

为了方便调试程序，可以设置 Lazarus 生成调试信息：Project → Project Options → Compiler Options，或者直接使用编译器命令行参数 -gw (DWARF) 并禁用优化（-O-）。

.FPC 编译器调试相关选项

[cols="2,7"]
|===
|选项	|说明

| -g	|标准调试信息 (Stabs) 
|-gw	|更现代的 DWARF 格式（推荐）
|-gl	|仅行号信息（轻量级）
|-Xg	|生成外部调试文件
|-O-	|禁用优化（方便调试）
|===

****
WARNING: 应用程序无法正常启动(0xc000007b)。请单击“确定”关闭应用程序。

错误 0xc000007b 通常是由于 32/64 位不兼容 或 缺少依赖的 DLL 文件 导致的。需要根据 FPC 版本来选择相应的 SDL3.dll。如果 FPC 显示的版本号包含 for x86_64 就是 64 位编译的版本，必须使用 Win32 x64 位 SDL3.dll。
****

除了 SDL3-for-Pascal 自带的示例程序，这里也提供一个基本的测试程序，只用绑定的 SDL3 API 来显示一个消息窗口。SDL 各种功能需要先初始化后才能使用，AUDIO，VIDEO，JOYSTICK，HAPTIC，GAMEPAD，EVENTS，SENSOR，CAMERA 等等。

.examples/hello.pas
[source,pascal]
----
program Hello;
{$AppType GUI}

uses SDL3;

begin

  //initilization of video subsystem
  if not SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) then 
  begin
    WriteLn('SDL initialize failure.');
    Exit;
  end;

  {your SDL2 application/game}
  SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_WARNING, 'First Steps', 'It works!', nil);

  //shutting down video subsystem
  SDL_Quit;
end.
----

然后是 makefile 脚本，配置了两个程序目标 (target) ，各自依赖一个 .pas 代码文件，通过 FPC 编译器命令对其进行编译。此脚本默认在 bin 子目录输出编译后端程序，并且为了避免在源代码目录产生临时文件，可以将 makefile 放到 bin 或其它子目录中执行。然后通过 “make test” 进行编译、运行测试。这里的 makefile 脚本为了简化 make 脚本的规则基本原理，都是在规律和依赖中硬编码程序源文件和输出的可执行程序文件。同时使用 --no-builtin-rules 避免 make 命令使用其内置的规则，内置的隐式规则非常强大，可以帮助自动处理流行的代码文件的编译。

.makefile
[source,makefile]
----
# Disable all built-in implicit rules
MAKEFLAGS += --no-builtin-rules

all: primitives.exe hello.exe

primitives.exe : ../examples/primitives.pas
	fpc -Fu../units -o../bin/primitives.exe ../examples/primitives.pas

hello.exe: ../examples/hello.pas
	fpc -gw -Fu../units -o../bin/hello.exe ../examples/hello.pas

test: all
	ldd ../bin/primitives
	../bin/primitives
	../bin/hello

clean:
	rm -f *.exe *.o
----

如果成功，应该可以看到程序调用 SDL3 产生的消息窗口，并且可以通过 ldd 工具看到 SDL3.dll 动态链接库正常识别并加载。如果未将 SDL3.dll 放置到 PATH 环境变量所指示的路径中，也没有将其放到程序所在目录中，那么使用 ldd 工具定位不到动态链接库就会显示 SDL3.dll => not found，运行测试程序也会提供确实 DLL 文件。

[source,makefile]
----
ldd ../bin/primitives
	ntdll.dll => /c/Windows/SYSTEM32/ntdll.dll (0x7ffd392d0000)
	KERNEL32.DLL => /c/Windows/System32/KERNEL32.DLL (0x7ffd39160000)
	......
	GDI32.dll => /c/Windows/System32/GDI32.dll (0x7ffd38f90000)
	gdi32full.dll => /c/Windows/System32/gdi32full.dll (0x7ffd37180000)
	SDL3.dll => /c/pl/SDL3FP/bin/SDL3.dll (0x6f8b0000)
../bin/primitives
../bin/hello
----

GNU make 作为一个自动化构建工具，显然前面的构建脚本是不够自动化的，因为依赖规则都通过字面量固定。也就是，新增加代码就不会去处理了。为了给自带化构建脚本上点强度，就需要使用 GNU make 内置的各种规则形式和内置函数，也包括内置的隐式规则。以下更新后的脚本可以自动检测 examples 目录下的代码文件，每个 .pas 对应生成一个 .exe 程序。脚本中使用 wildcard 函数动态的获取代码文件列表，然后经过 patsubst 做字符串替换得到文件名（无扩展名），这些文件名将作为 all 目标的先决条件。配合 %.exe 模式规则，就可以匹配所有与文件名关联的程序目标，然后调用编译进行编译。模式规则中有几点要说明：$@ 和 $< 这样的使用美元符号开头的是变量，这两个是特殊变量，分别对应规则名称（$@）以及目标的先决条件（源代码文件）。最后是 test 这个目标，它依赖 all，并且在所以程序构建完成后执行它。使用了 foreach 循环目标列表，再通过 shell 函数执行这些编译好的程序。

[source,makefile]
----
files:=$(wildcard ../examples/*.pas)
targets:=$(patsubst ../examples/%.pas,%.exe,$(files))
$(info All targets: $(targets))

all: $(targets)

# make some_example
%.exe: ../examples/%.pas
	fpc -gw -Fu../units -o../bin/$@ $<

# make test
test: all
	ldd ../bin/hello
	$(foreach exe,$(targets),$(shell "./$(exe)"))
#	$(shell echo ./$$(ls -t *.exe | head -n1))

# make test-some_example
test-%: %.exe
	$(shell echo ../bin/$<)

clean:
	rm -f *.exe *.o
----


.Free Pascal 绑定 SDL3 的代码片段参考
[source,pascal]
----
unit sdl3;

interface

{$IFDEF           |FPC}
{$MODE            |DELPHI}
{$PACKRECORDS     |C}
{$ENDIF}

// Define SDL3 types and functions
type
  PSDL_Window = ^TSDL_Window;
  TSDL_Window = record
    // SDL window structure
  end;

// Function prototypes
function SDL_Init(flags: UInt32): Integer; cdecl; external 'SDL3';
function SDL_CreateWindow(title: PChar; width, height: Integer): PSDL_Window; cdecl; external 'SDL3';
procedure SDL_DestroyWindow(window: PSDL_Window); cdecl; external 'SDL3';

implementation

end.

// Compile with SDL3 Library:
// Ensure the SDL3 library is in the linker path. Use FPC flags:
// fpc -k-lSDL3 your_program.pas
----

[[PR009]]

=== About this guide

This document serves as the reference for the Pascal language as implemented by the Free Pascal compiler. It describes all Pascal constructs supported by Free Pascal, and lists all supported data types. It does not, however, give a detailed explanation of the Pascal language: it is not a tuto rial. The aim is to list which Pascal constructs are supported, and to show where the Free Pascal implementation differs from the Turbo Pascal or Delphi implementations.

The Turbo Pascal and Delphi Pascal compilers introduced various features in the Pascal language. The Free Pascal compiler emulates these compilers in the appropriate mode of the compiler: certain features are available only if the compiler is switched to the appropriate mode. When required for a certain feature, the use of the-M command-line switch or {$MODE } directive will be indicated in the text. More information about the various modes can be found in the user’s manual and the programmer’s manual.

Earlier versions of this document also contained the reference documentation of the system unit and objpas unit. This has been moved to the RTL reference guide.

=== Notations

Throughout this document, we will refer to functions, types and variables with typewriter font. Files are referred to with a sans font: filename.

=== Syntax diagrams

All elements of the Pascal language are explained in syntax diagrams. Syntax diagrams are like flow charts. Reading a syntax diagram means getting from the left side to the right side, following the arrows. When the right side of a syntax diagram is reached, and it ends with a single arrow, this means the syntax diagram is continued on the next line. If the line ends on two arrows pointing to each other, then the diagram is ended.

Syntactical elements are written like this

 syntactical elements are like this : ...

Keywords which must be typed exactly as in the diagram:

 **_keywords are like this_**

When something can be repeated, there is an arrow around it:

 { this can be repeated } •••

When there are different possibilities, they are listed in rows:

 { Firstpossibility | Second possibility }

Note, that one of the possibilities can be empty:

 [ First possibility | Second possibility ]

This means that both the first or second possibility are optional. Of course, all these elements can be combined and nested.

=== About the Pascal language

The language Pascal was originally designed by Niklaus Wirth around 1970. It has evolved significantly since that day, with a lot of contributions by the various compiler constructors (Notably: Borland). The basic elements have been kept throughout the years:

 • Easy syntax, rather verbose, yet easy to read. Ideal for teaching.
 • Strongly typed.
 • Procedural.
 • Case insensitive.
 • Allows nested procedures.
 • Easy input/output routines built-in.

The Turbo Pascal and Delphi Pascal compilers introduced various features in the Pascal language, most notably easier string handling and object orientedness. The Free Pascal compiler initially emu lated most of Turbo Pascal and later on Delphi. It emulates these compilers in the appropriate mode of the compiler: certain features are available only if the compiler is switched to the appropriate mode. When required for a certain feature, the use of the-M command-line switch or {$MODE } directive will be indicated in the text. More information about the various modes can be found in the user’s manual and the programmer’s manual.

=== Appendix A Pascal grammar
https://www.freepascal.org/daily/doc/ref/refap1.html[HTML] or
https://gitlab.com/freepascal.org/fpc/documentation/-/blob/main/ObjectPascal.ebnf[ObjectPascal.ebnf]

[.text-center.big.olive]
Reference guide for Free Pascal, version 3.2.4 +
Document version 3.2.4 +
July 2025 +

Below is a formal grammar of the pascal language in EBNF notation. It is not 100% complete, some parts such as assembler or objective-c have not been specified.

转换 Free Pascal 语法规则时发现 HTML 格式中渲染的图片有些可能存在错误的地方，按照经验以及 EBNF 语法文档中使用 { ( "_"| binary_digit ) } 这样的形式表达重复项，修改了 ⟨identifier⟩ 和 ⟨comment⟩ 等等规则。HTML 中渲染的语法图是错误的格式，通过比对 ObjectPascal.ebnf 源文件确实 HTML 文档存在多处错误。

•   toplevel: compile module
** <<SX01, Program>>
** <<SX02, Library>>
** <<SX03, Package>>
** <<SX04, unit>> •  <<XS01, block: procedure/function>> •  <<XS02, labels>> •  <<XS03, Constants>> •  <<XS04, Variables>> •  <<XS05, types>> •  <<XS06, record type>> •  <<XS07, object type>> •  <<XS08, class declaration>> •  <<XS09, Interface type>> •  <<XS10, Generic type>> •  <<XS11, Helper typ>> •  <<XS12, Expressions>> •  <<XS13, Statements>> •  <<XS14, Procedure and function declarations>> •  <<XS15, scanner/lexer>>

[source,grammar,subs=normal]
----
( toplevel: compile module  )
  ⟨module⟩ = ⟨program_module⟩ | ⟨library_module⟩ | ⟨package_modvie⟩ | ⟨unit_module⟩ ;

( [[SX01]]: Program )
          ⟨program_module⟩ = ⟨program_header⟩ _“;”_ | ⟨full_uses_clause⟩] ⟨block⟩ _“.”_ ;
          ⟨program_header⟩ = _“program”_ ⟨identifier⟩ | _“(”_ ⟨program_parameters⟩ _“)”_ ] ;
      ⟨program_parameters⟩ = ⟨identifier_list⟩;
        ⟨full_uses_clause⟩ = _“uses”_ ⟨full_uses_item⟩ _“,”_ ⟨full_uses_item⟩ _“;”_
          ⟨full_uses_item⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ | _“in”_ ⟨string_literal⟩] ;


( [[SX02]]: Library )

          ⟨library_module⟩ = ⟨library_header⟩ _“;”_ | ⟨uses_clause⟩] ⟨block⟩ _“.”_ ;
          ⟨library_header⟩ = _“library”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ;

( [[SX03]]: Package )

          ⟨package_module⟩ = ⟨package_header⟩ _“;”_ | ⟨contains_clause⟩ ] [⟨requires_clause⟩]
                             _“end”_ _“.”_ 
          ⟨package_header⟩ = _“package”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ;
         ⟨contains_clause⟩ = _“contains”_ ⟨full_uses_item⟩ ⟨full_uses_item⟩ _“;”_
         ⟨requires_clause⟩ = _“requires”_ ⟨qualifier_list⟩”; 


( [[SX04]]: unit )

             ⟨unit_module⟩ = ⟨unit_header⟩ ⟨interface_section⟩ ⟨implementation⟩ 
                             ( [⟨initiatization_section⟩] [⟨finalization_section⟩] 
                             | [”begin” ⟨statement_list⟩] )
                             _“end”_ _“.”_ 
             ⟨unit_header⟩ = _“unit”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ | ⟨hint_directives⟩ ] _“;”_ ;
       ⟨interface_section⟩ = _“interface”_ [⟨uses_clause⟩] [⟨interface_parts⟩] ;
             ⟨uses_clause⟩ = _“uses”_ ⟨identifier⟩ _“,”_ ⟨identifier⟩ _“;”_ ;
         ⟨interface_parts⟩ = ⟨interface_part⟩ ⟨interface_part⟩ ; 
          ⟨interface_part⟩ = ⟨constant_declaration_block⟩ 
                          |     ⟨type_declaration_block⟩ 
                          | ⟨variable_declaration_block⟩
                          | ⟨Property_declaration_block⟩
                          | ⟨procedure_headers_block⟩ ;
  ⟨implementation_section⟩ = _“implementation”_ [⟨uses_clause⟩] ⟨declaration_part⟩ ;
  ⟨initiatization_section⟩ = _“initialization”_ ⟨statement_list⟩ ;
    ⟨finalization_section⟩ = _“finalization”_ ⟨statement_list⟩ ; 
          ⟨exports_clause⟩ = _“exports”_ ⟨exports_list⟩ 
            ⟨exports_list⟩ = ⟨exports_entry⟩ _“,”_ ⟨exports_entry⟩ ;
           ⟨exports_entry⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ [”index” ⟨integer_constant⟩]
                            [”name” ⟨string_constant⟩] 


( [[XS01]]: block: procedure/function )

     ⟨procedure_headers_block⟩ = ⟨procedure_header⟩ 
                              | ⟨function_header⟩
                              | ⟨operator_header⟩;
            ⟨procedure_header⟩ = ⟨generic_procedure_header⟩ | ⟨regular_procedure_header⟩ ;
    ⟨generic_procedure_header⟩ = _“generic”_ _“procedure”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ⟨generic_template_list⟩ 
                                ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ _“;”_ 
                                [ ⟨call_modifiers⟩ _“;”_ ] [⟨hint_directives⟩] ; 
    ⟨regular_procedure_header⟩ = _“procedure”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ [⟨generic_template_list⟩] 
                                ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ _“;”_ 
                                [ ⟨call_modifiers⟩ _“;”_ ] [⟨hint_directives⟩] ;
             ⟨function_header⟩ = ⟨generic_function_header⟩ | ⟨regular_function_header⟩;
     ⟨generic_function_header⟩ = _“generic”_ _“function”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ 
                                [ _“¡”_ ⟨generic_template_list⟩ _“¿”_ ]
                                ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ 
                                [ ⟨call_modifiers⟩ _“;”_] [⟨hint_directives⟩] ;
     ⟨regular_function_header⟩ = _“function”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ [ _“¡”_ ⟨generic_template_list⟩ _“¿”_]
                                ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ 
                                [ ⟨call_modifiers⟩ _“;”_] [⟨hint_directives⟩] ;
             ⟨operator_header⟩ = _“operator”_ ⟨operator_definition⟩ [⟨result_identifier⟩] _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ ;
         ⟨operator_definition⟩ =        ⟨assignment_operator_definition⟩ 
                              |        ⟨arithmetic_operator_definition⟩
                              |        ⟨comparison_operator_definition⟩
                              |           ⟨logicaLToperator_definition⟩
                              |             ⟨other_operator_definition⟩ ;
       ⟨generic_template_list⟩ = ⟨constrained_template_list⟩ ⟨free_template_list⟩ ;
   ⟨constrained_template_list⟩ = ⟨constrained_templates⟩ “; ⟨constrained_templates⟩ ;
          ⟨free_template_list⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ _“,”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ;
       ⟨constrained_templates⟩ = ⟨identifier_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type_constraint⟩ ⟨type_constraint⟩ ;
             ⟨identifier_list⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ _“,”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ;
             ⟨type_constraint⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ | _“class”_ | _“record”_ ;
                       ⟨block⟩ = ⟨declaration_block⟩ ⟨statement_block⟩ ;
           ⟨declaration_block⟩ =              ⟨label_declaration_block⟩
                              |            ⟨constant_declaration_block⟩
                              |      ⟨resourcestring_declaration_block⟩
                              | _“class”_ ⟨func_proc_declaration_block⟩
                              |           ⟨func_proc_declaration_block⟩
                              |                ⟨type_declaration_block⟩
                              |            ⟨variable_declaration_block⟩
                              |      ⟨threadvariable_declaration_block⟩
                              | ⟨exports_clause⟩ ;
 ⟨func_proc_declaration_block⟩ =                 ⟨procedure_declaration⟩
                              |                  ⟨function_declaration⟩
                              |               ⟨constructor_declaration⟩
                              |                ⟨destructor_declaration⟩
                              |                  ⟨operator_declaration⟩ ;
             ⟨statement_block⟩ = ⟨compound_statement⟩ ;


( [[XS02]]: labels )

     ⟨label_declaration_block⟩ = _“label”_ ⟨label_def⟩ [_“,”_ ⟨label_def⟩] _“;”_ ;


( [[XS03]]: Constants )

       ⟨constant_declaration_block⟩ = _“const”_ ⟨constant_declaration⟩ [⟨hint_directives⟩] ;
             ⟨constant_declaration⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ _“:”_ ⟨constant_expression⟩ _“;”_
                                   | ⟨identifier⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ _“=”_ ⟨constant_expression⟩ _“;”_ ;
 ⟨resourcestring_declaration_block⟩ = _“resourcestring”_ ⟨string_constant_declaration⟩ ;
      ⟨string_constant_declaration⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ _“=”_ ⟨string_constant_literal⟩ _“;”_ ;
       ⟨variable_declaration_block⟩ = _“var”_ ⟨variable_declaration⟩ ;
 ⟨threadvariable_declaration_block⟩ = _“threadvar”_ ⟨variable_declaration⟩ ;


( [[XS04]]: Variables )

   ⟨variable_declaration⟩ = ⟨identifier_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ [ _“=”_ ⟨expression⟩] 
                             [variable modifiers⟩] [⟨hint_directives⟩];
     ⟨variable_modifiers⟩ = _“absolute”_ ⟨absolute_target⟩ 
                         | _“;”_ _“export”_
                         | _“cvar”_
                         | _“external”_ [⟨string_constant⟩] [”name” ⟨string_constant⟩] ;
        ⟨absolute_target⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ | ⟨expression⟩ ;


( [[XS05]]: types )

 ⟨type_declaration_block⟩ = _“type”_ ⟨type_declaration⟩
         ⟨hint_directive⟩ = _“deprecated”_ [⟨string_constant⟩] 
                         | _“experimental”_ 
                         | _“platform”_ 
                         | _“unimplemented”_ ;
        ⟨hint_directives⟩ = ⟨hint_directive⟩ _“;”_ ⟨hint_directive⟩ ;
         ⟨typed_constant⟩ = ⟨factor⟩ | ⟨proceduraLtconstant⟩ ;
       ⟨type_declaration⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ _“=”_ ⟨type⟩ [⟨hint_directives⟩] _“;”_ ;
                   ⟨type⟩ = [”type”] ⟨simple_type⟩ 
                         |         ⟨pointer_type⟩ 
                         |  ⟨full_procedure_type⟩
                         |   ⟨forward_class_type⟩
                         |      ⟨structured_type⟩
                         | ⟨class_reference_type⟩
                         |         ⟨generic_type⟩
                         |     ⟨specialized_type⟩
                         | _“helper”_ ⟨helper_type⟩ ;
     ⟨forward_class_type⟩ = _“class”_ ;
   ⟨class_reference_type⟩ = _“class”_ _“of”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ;
           ⟨pointer_type⟩ = ⟨qualifier⟩ ;
            ⟨simple_type⟩ = ⟨string_type⟩ ⟨ordinal_type⟩ ;
            ⟨string_type⟩ = _“string”_ _“[”_ ⟨constant_expression⟩ _“]”_ 
                         | _“string”_ _“(”_ ⟨positive_integer⟩ _“)”_
                         | _“ansistring”_
                         | _“widestring”_
                         | _“unicodestring”_ ;
              ⟨type_name⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ ;
          ⟨subrange_type⟩ = ⟨simple_constant_expression⟩ _“..”_ ⟨simple_constant_expression⟩ ;
           ⟨ordinal_type⟩ = ⟨enumerated_type⟩ | ⟨builtin_ordinal⟩ | ⟨subrange_type⟩ ;
        ⟨builtin_ordinal⟩ = _“byte”_ 
                         | _“shortint”_ 
                         | _“word”_ 
                         | _“smallint”_ 
                         | _“cardinal”_ 
                         | _“longint”_ 
                         | _“qword”_ 
                         | _“int84”_ ;
        ⟨enumerated_type⟩ = _“(”_ ⟨enumerated_item⟩ _“,”_ ⟨enumerated_item⟩ _“)”_ ;
        ⟨enumerated_item⟩ = ⟨qualifier⟩ 
                         | ⟨qualifier⟩ _“=”_ ⟨expression⟩ 
                         | ⟨qualifier⟩ _“:=”_ ⟨expression⟩ ;
        ⟨structured_type⟩ = ⟨set_type⟩
                         | ⟨file_type⟩
                         | ⟨intedaee_type⟩ 
                         | _“packed”_ ⟨unpacked_type⟩ 
                         | _“bitpacked”_ ⟨unpacked_type⟩ ;
          ⟨unpacked_type⟩ = ⟨array_type⟩ 
                         | ⟨record_type⟩
                         | ⟨object_type⟩
                         | ⟨class_type⟩ ;
               ⟨set_type⟩ = _“set”_ _“of”_ ⟨ordinal_type⟩ ;
              ⟨file_type⟩ = _“file”_ _“of”_ ⟨type⟩ ] | _“te t”_ ;
             ⟨array_type⟩ = _“array”_ [ _“[”_ ⟨ordinal_type⟩ _“,”_ ordinal type⟩ _“]”_ ] _“of”_ ⟨type⟩ ;
         ⟨qualifier_list⟩ = ⟨qualifier⟩ _“,”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ;


( [[XS06]]: record type )

                 ⟨record_type⟩ = _“record”_ ⟨record_component_list⟩ [⟨variant_part⟩] [ _“;”_] _“end”_ ;
       ⟨record_component_list⟩ = ⟨record_visibility_specifier⟩
                              | ⟨field_definition⟩ [ _“;”_]
                              | ⟨record_method_definition⟩
                              | ⟨Property_definition⟩
                              | ⟨record_operator_definition⟩ ;
            ⟨field_definition⟩ = ⟨identifier_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ ;
                ⟨variant_part⟩ = _“case”_ [⟨identifier⟩ _“:”_] ⟨type⟩ _“of”_ ⟨variant_case⟩ [ _“;”_ [⟨variant_case⟩]] ;
                ⟨variant_case⟩ = ⟨constant⟩ _“,”_ ⟨constant⟩ _“:”_ _“(”_ ⟨variant_field_list⟩ _“)”_ ;
          ⟨variant_field_list⟩ = ⟨field_definition⟩ _“;”_ ⟨field_definition⟩ ;
 ⟨record_visibility_specifier⟩ = _“public”_ | [ _“strict”_ ] _“private”_ ;
    ⟨record_method_definition⟩ = ⟨function_header⟩ | ⟨procedure_header⟩;
  ⟨record_operator_definition⟩ = _“class”_ ⟨operator_header⟩;
         ⟨full_procedure_type⟩ = ⟨procedure_type⟩ [ _“;”_ ⟨call_modifiers⟩];
              ⟨procedure_type⟩ = ⟨func_proc_header⟩ 
                              | ⟨func_proc_header⟩ _“of”_ _“object”_ 
                              | ⟨func_proc_header⟩ _“is”_ _“nested”_ ;
            ⟨func_proc_header⟩ = _“function”_ ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ [ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩] 
                              | _“procedure”_ ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩;
              ⟨call_modifiers⟩ = _“inline”_ 
                              | _“register”_ 
                              | _“cdecl”_ 
                              | _“cppdecl”_ 
                              | _“pascal”_ 
                              | _“stdcall”_ 
                              | _“safecall”_ 
                              | _“hardfloat”_ 
                              | _“local”_
                              | _“mwpascal”_
                              | _“msxabixdefault”_
                              | _“msxabixcdecl”_
                              | _“nostackframe”_
                              | _“saveregisters”_
                              | _“softfloat”_
                              | _“sysvxabixdefault”_
                              | _“sysvxabixcdecl”_
                              | _“vectorcall”_
                              | _“varargs”_
         ⟨property_definition⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ [⟨property_interface⟩] ⟨property_specifiers⟩ ;
          ⟨property_interface⟩ = [⟨property_parameter_list⟩] _“:”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ;
     ⟨property_parameter_tist⟩ = _“[”_ ⟨parameter_declaration⟩ _“;”_ ⟨parameter_declaration⟩ _“]”_
         ⟨property_specifiers⟩ = [_“index”_ ⟨expression⟩] [⟨read_specifier⟩] [⟨write_specifier⟩] [⟨default_specifier⟩] ;
              ⟨read_specifier⟩ = _“read”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ;
             ⟨write_specifier⟩ = _“write”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ;
           ⟨default_specifier⟩ = _“default”_ [⟨constant⟩] | _“nodefault”_ ;


( [[XS07]]: object type )

                 ⟨object_type⟩ = _“object”_ [_“abstract”_ | _“sealed”_] [⟨heritage⟩] ⟨object_component⟩ _“end”_ ; 
                    ⟨heritage⟩ = _“(”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ _“)”_ ;
            ⟨object_component⟩ = ⟨object_visibility_specifier⟩
                              | ⟨constant_declaration_block⟩
                              | ⟨type_declaration_block⟩
                              | ⟨object_field_definition⟩ 
                              | ⟨object_method_definition⟩
                              | ⟨property_declaration_block⟩ ; 
 ⟨object_visibility_specifier⟩ = _“private”_ | _“protected”_ | _“public”_ ;
     ⟨object_field_definition⟩ = [[⟨class⟩] ⟨var⟩ ] ⟨identifier_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ _“;”_ [_“static”_ _“;”_] 
    ⟨object_method_definition⟩ = ⟨constructor_header⟩ [⟨method_directives⟩]
                              | ⟨destructor_header⟩ [⟨method_directives⟩]
                              | ⟨method_definition⟩ [⟨method_directives⟩] ;
           ⟨method_definition⟩ = [⟨class⟩] ⟨function_header⟩ 
                              | [⟨class⟩] ⟨procedure_header⟩ 
                              | [⟨class⟩] ⟨operator_header⟩ ;
          ⟨constructor_header⟩ = _“constructor”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩;
           ⟨destructor_header⟩ = _“destructor”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ ;
           ⟨method_directives⟩ = [_“virtual”_ _“;”_ [(_“abstract”_ | _“reintroduce”_) _“;”_ ]] [⟨call_modifiers⟩ _“;”_ ] ;


( [[XS08]]: class declaration )

                 ⟨class_type⟩ = _“class”_ [_“abstract”_ | _“sealed”_] [⟨class_heritage⟩] ⟨class_component⟩ [_“end”_] ;
             ⟨class_heritage⟩ = _“(”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ _“,”_ ⟨qualifier⟩ _“)”_
            ⟨class_component⟩ = ⟨class_visibility_specifier⟩
                             | ⟨constant_declaration_block⟩
                             | ⟨type_declaration_block⟩
                             | [⟨class⟩] ⟨var_declaration_block⟩
                             | ⟨class_field_definition⟩ _“;”_
                             | ⟨class_method_definition⟩ _“;”_
                             | ⟨class_property_definition⟩ _“;”_ ;
 ⟨class_visibility_specifier⟩ = [_“strict”_] _“private”_ 
                             | [_“strict”_] _“protected”_ 
                             | _“public”_ 
                             | _“published”_ ;
    ⟨class_method_definition⟩ = ⟨constructor_header⟩
                             | ⟨destructor_header⟩
                             | ⟨method_definition⟩ [⟨class_method_directives⟩ _“;”_] [⟨call_modifiers⟩ _“;”_] ;
    ⟨class_method_directives⟩ = _“virtual”_ [⟨abstract_or_reintroduce⟩] 
                             | _“dynamic”_ [⟨abstract_or_reintroduce⟩]
                             | _“override”_ [_“;”_ _“final”_]
                             | _“reintroduce”_ [_“;”_ _“virtual”_]
                             | _“message”_ ( ⟨integer_constant⟩ | ⟨string_constant⟩ )
                             | _“static”_ [_“;”_ _“inline”_] ; 
    ⟨abstract_or_reintroduce⟩ = _“;”_ (”abstract” [_“;”_ _“overload”_] | _“reintroduce”_ ) ;
     ⟨class_field_definition⟩ = ⟨identifier_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨type⟩ _“;”_ [_“static”_ _“;”_ ] ;
  ⟨class_property_definition⟩ = _“property”_ ⟨identifier⟩ [⟨property_interface⟩] 
                               ⟨class_property_specifiers⟩ [⟨hint_directives⟩] _“;”_ ;
  ⟨class_property_specifiers⟩ = [_“index”_ ⟨expression⟩] [⟨read_specifier⟩] 
                               [⟨write_specifier⟩ | ⟨implements_specifier⟩] 
                               [⟨default_specifier⟩] [⟨stored_specifier⟩] [_“default”_ ] ;
       ⟨implements_specifier⟩ = _“implements”_ ⟨identifier⟩ _“,”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ;
           ⟨stored_specifier⟩ = _“stored”_ ⟨identifier⟩;

( [[XS09]]: Interface type )

                ⟨interface_type⟩ = ⟨interface⟩ [⟨heritage⟩] [⟨guid⟩] ⟨interface_component⟩ _“end”_;
           ⟨interface_component⟩ = ⟨function_header⟩ [_“;”_ ⟨call_modifiers⟩] _“;”_
                                | ⟨procedure_header⟩ [_“;”_ ⟨call_modifiers⟩] _“;”_
                                | ⟨class_property_definition⟩ _“;”_ ;
 ⟨interface_property_specifiers⟩ = [_“index”_ ⟨expression⟩] [⟨read_specifier⟩] [⟨write_specifier⟩]
                                   [⟨default_specifier⟩] [_“default”_] ;
                          ⟨guid⟩ = _“[”_ ⟨string_constant⟩ _“]”_ ;


( [[XS10]]: Generic type )

      ⟨generic_type⟩ = [_“generic”_] ⟨identifier⟩ _“¡”_ ⟨generic_template_list⟩ _“¿”_ _“=”_ ⟨generic_type_def⟩ 
  ⟨generic_type_def⟩ = ⟨class_type⟩ 
                    | ⟨object_type⟩ 
                    | ⟨interface_type⟩ 
                    | ⟨procedure_type⟩ 
                    | ⟨record_type⟩ 
                    | ⟨array_type⟩ ;
  ⟨specialized_type⟩ = [_“specialize”_] ⟨identifier⟩ _“¡”_ ⟨qualifier_list⟩ _“¿”_ ;


( [[XS11]]: Helper type)

             ⟨helper_type⟩ = ( ⟨class⟩ | ⟨record⟩ | ⟨type⟩ ) _“helper”_ [_“(”_ ⟨base_helper⟩ _“)”_] ⟨for⟩
                            ⟨qualifier⟩ ⟨helper_component_list⟩ _“end”_ [⟨hint_directives⟩] ;
   ⟨helper_component_list⟩ = ⟨helper_component⟩ _“;”_ ⟨helper_component⟩ ;
        ⟨helper_component⟩ = ⟨method_definition⟩ | ⟨property_definition⟩ ;
 ⟨constructor_declaration⟩ = ⟨constructor_header⟩ _“;”_ ⟨subroutine_block⟩ _“;”_ ;
  ⟨destructor_declaration⟩ = ⟨destructor_header⟩ _“;”_ ⟨subroutine_block⟩ _“;”_ ;


( [[XS12]]: Expressions )

                            ⟨expression⟩ = ⟨simple_expression⟩ [⟨relop⟩ ⟨simple_expression⟩] ; 
                                 ⟨relop⟩ = _“¡”_ | _“¡=”_ | _“¿”_ | _“¿=”_ | _“=”_ | _“¡¿”_ | _“in”_ | _“is”_ ;
                     ⟨simple_expression⟩ = ⟨term⟩ ⟨addop⟩ ⟨term⟩ ;
            ⟨simple_constant_expression⟩ = ⟨simple_expression⟩ ;
                                 ⟨addop⟩ = _“{PLUS}”_ | _“-”_ | _“or”_ | _“xor”_ | _“¿¡”_ ;
                                  ⟨term⟩ = ⟨factor⟩ ⟨multop⟩ ⟨factor⟩ ;
                                ⟨multop⟩ = _“\*”_ | _“/”_ | _“div”_ | _“mod”_ | _“and”_ | _“shl”_ | _“shr”_ | _“as”_ | _“¡¡”_ | _“¿¿”_ ;
                                ⟨factor⟩ = ⟨nested_expr_or_structured_const⟩ ⟨selector⟩ 
                                        | ⟨varref_or_funcall_or_constid_or_cast⟩ 
                                        | ⟨unsigned_constant⟩ 
                                        | _“not”_ ⟨factor⟩ 
                                        | ⟨sign⟩ ⟨factor⟩
                                        | ⟨set_constructor⟩
                                        | ⟨address_factor⟩
                                        | ⟨inherited_call⟩ ;
  ⟨varref_or_funcall_or_constid_or_cast⟩ = ⟨qualifier⟩ [ ⟨actual_parameter_list⟩ ] ;
       ⟨nested_expr_or_structured_const⟩ = _“(”_ ⟨element⟩ ( _“,”_ | ;”) [ ⟨element⟩ ] _“)”_ ;
                               ⟨element⟩ = [ _“:”_ ⟨identifier⟩ _“:”_ ] ⟨expression⟩ ;
                     ⟨unsigned_constant⟩ = ⟨unsigned_number⟩ | ⟨character_string⟩ | _“nil”_
                                  ⟨sign⟩ = _“{PLUS}”_ | _“-”_ ;
                 ⟨actual_parameter_list⟩ = _“[”_ [ ⟨expression⟩ _“,”_ ⟨expression⟩ ] _“)”_ ;
                       ⟨set_constructor⟩ = _“[”_ [ ⟨set_group⟩ _“,”_ ⟨set_group⟩ ] _“]”_ ;
                             ⟨set_group⟩ = ⟨expression⟩ | _“..”_ ⟨expression⟩ ; 
                        ⟨address_factor⟩ = _“@”_ ( ⟨designator⟩ | ⟨nested_expr_or_structured_const⟩ ) ;

                        
( [[XS13]]: Statements )

        ⟨statement_list⟩ = ⟨statement⟩ _“;”_ [⟨statement⟩] ;
             ⟨statement⟩ = [ ⟨label_def⟩ _“:”_ ] ⟨unlabeled_statement⟩ ;
   ⟨unlabeled_statement⟩ = ⟨simple_statement⟩ ⟨structured_statement⟩ ⟨asm_statement⟩ ;
      ⟨simple_statement⟩ = ⟨inherited_call⟩ | ⟨assignment_call⟩ | ⟨goto_statement⟩ | ⟨raise_statement⟩ ;
        ⟨inherited_call⟩ = _“inherited”_ [ ⟨identifier⟩ [ ⟨actual_parameter_list⟩ ] ] ;
       ⟨assignment_call⟩ = ( ⟨designator⟩ | ⟨nested_expr_or_structured_const⟩ ⟨selector⟩ ) 
                           [ ⟨assignop⟩ ⟨expression⟩ ] ; 
              ⟨assignop⟩ = _“:=”_ | _“{PLUS}=”_ | _“-=”_ | _“*=”_ | _“/=”_ ;
        ⟨goto_statement⟩ = ⟨goto⟩ ⟨label_def⟩ ;
  ⟨structured_statement⟩ = ⟨compound_statement⟩
                        | ⟨conditional_statement⟩
                        | ⟨loop_statement⟩
                        | ⟨with_statement⟩
                        | ⟨try_statement⟩ ; 
 ⟨conditional_statement⟩ = ⟨case_statement⟩ | ⟨if_statement⟩ ;
        ⟨loop_statement⟩ = ⟨for_statement⟩  | ⟨repeat_statement⟩ | ⟨while_statement⟩ ; 
    ⟨compound_statement⟩ = _“begin”_ ⟨statement_list⟩ _“end”_ ;
        ⟨case_statement⟩ = ⟨case⟩ ⟨expression⟩ _“of”_ ⟨case_part⟩ _“;”_ ⟨case_part⟩ [ ⟨else_part⟩ ] _“end”_ ;
             ⟨case_part⟩ = ⟨case_range⟩ _“,”_ ⟨case_range⟩ _“:”_ ⟨statement⟩ ;
            ⟨case_range⟩ = ⟨constant_expression⟩ [ _“..”_ ⟨constant_expression⟩ ] ;
             ⟨else_part⟩ = _“;”_ ( ⟨else⟩ | _“otherwise”_ ) ⟨statement_list⟩ ;
          ⟨if_statement⟩ = ⟨if⟩ ⟨expression⟩ ⟨then⟩ ⟨statement⟩ [ ⟨else⟩ ⟨statement⟩ ] ;
         ⟨for_statement⟩ = ⟨for_to_statement⟩ ⟨for_down_to_statement⟩ ⟨for_in_statement⟩ ;
      ⟨for_to_statement⟩ = ⟨for⟩ ⟨identifier⟩ _“:=”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“to”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“do”_ ⟨statement⟩ 
  ⟨for_downto_statement⟩ = ⟨for⟩ ⟨identifier⟩ _“:=”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“downto”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“do”_ ⟨statement⟩ ; 
      ⟨for_in_statement⟩ = ⟨for⟩ ⟨identifier⟩ ⟨in⟩ ⟨enumerate⟩ _“do”_ ⟨statement⟩ ;
             ⟨enumerate⟩ = ⟨enumerated_type⟩ | ⟨designator⟩ | ⟨set_constructor⟩ ;
      ⟨repeat_statement⟩ = _“repeat”_ ⟨statement_list⟩ _“until”_ ⟨expression⟩ ;
       ⟨while_statement⟩ = _“while”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“do”_ ⟨statement⟩ ;
        ⟨with_statement⟩ = _“with”_ ⟨variable_ref_erence⟩ _“,”_ ⟨variable_reference⟩ “do ⟨statement⟩ 
         ⟨asm_statement⟩ = _“asm”_ ⟨asm_statement_list⟩ _“end”_ [ ⟨register_list⟩ ] ;
         ⟨register_list⟩ = _“[”_ ⟨string_constant⟩ _“,”_ ⟨string_constant⟩ _“]”_ ;
       ⟨raise_statement⟩ = _“raise”_ | ⟨expression⟩ | ⟨exception_address⟩] ] ;
     ⟨exception_address⟩ = _“at”_ ⟨expression⟩ [ _“,”_ ⟨expression⟩ ] ;
         ⟨try_statement⟩ = _“try”_ ⟨statement_list⟩ 
                        (_“except”_ ⟨exception_handiers⟩ | _“finally”_ ⟨statement_list⟩ )
                         _“end”_ ;
    ⟨exception_handiers⟩ = [ ⟨statement_list⟩ | ⟨exception_handier⟩ ( ⟨else⟩ ⟨statement_list⟩ ] ];
     ⟨exception_handier⟩ = _“on”_ [ ⟨identifier⟩ _“:”_ ] ⟨type_name⟩ _“do”_ ⟨statement⟩


( [[XS14]]: Procedure and function declarations )

          ⟨procedure_declaration⟩ = ⟨procedure_header⟩ _“;”_ ⟨subroutine_block⟩ _“;”_ ;
               ⟨subroutine_block⟩ = ⟨block⟩ | ⟨external_directive⟩ | ⟨asm_block⟩ | _“forward”_ ;
           ⟨function_declaration⟩ = ⟨function_header⟩ _“;”_ ⟨subroutine_block⟩ _“;”_ ;
          ⟨formal_parameter_list⟩ = [ _“(”_ ⟨parameter_declaration⟩ _“;”_ ⟨parameter_declaration⟩ ;
          ⟨parameter_declaration⟩ = ⟨constant_parameter⟩ 
                                 | ⟨value_parameter⟩ 
                                 | ⟨variable_parameter⟩ 
                                 | ⟨out_parameter⟩ ;
                ⟨valve_parameter⟩ = ⟨identifier_list⟩ _“:”_ ⟨parameter_type⟩ [ _“=”_ ⟨default_parameter_value⟩ ] ;
             ⟨variable_parameter⟩ = _“var”_ ⟨identifier_list⟩ [ _“:”_ ⟨parameter_type⟩ ] ; 
                  ⟨out_parameter⟩ = _“out”_ ⟨identifier_list⟩ [ _“:”_ ⟨parameter_type⟩ ] ;
             ⟨constant_parameter⟩ = (_“const”_ | _“constref”_) ⟨identifier_list⟩ 
                                    [_“:”_ ⟨parameter_type⟩ [_“=”_ ⟨default_parameter_value⟩] ] ;
                 ⟨parameter_type⟩ = [ _“array”_ _“of”_ ] ( ⟨qualifier⟩ | _“coast”_ ) ;
             ⟨external_directive⟩ = _“external”_ [ ⟨string_constant⟩ [_“name”_ ⟨string_constant⟩ | _“index”_ ⟨integer_constant⟩] ] ;
                      ⟨asm_block⟩ = _“assembler”_ _“;”_ ⟨asm_statement_list⟩ ;
                      ⟨modifiers⟩ = _“;”_ ⟨modifier⟩ _“;”_ ⟨modifier⟩ ;
                       ⟨modifier⟩ = _“export”_ 
                                 | _“alias”_ _“:”_ ⟨string_constant⟩
                                 | _“interrupt”_ 
                                 | _“noreturn”_
                                 | _“iocheck”_
                                 | ⟨call_modifier⟩ ;
        ⟨operator_implementation⟩ = ⟨operator_header⟩ _“;”_ ⟨subroutine_block⟩ _“;”_ ;
 ⟨assignment_operator_definition⟩ = (_“:=”_ | _“explicit”_ | _“implicit”_) _“(”_ ⟨parameter_list⟩ _“)”_ ;
 ⟨arithmetic_operator_definition⟩ = (_“{PLUS}”_  
                                 | _“-”_ 
                                 | _“\*”_  
                                 | _“/”_ 
                                 | _“**”_ 
                                 | _“¿¡”_ 
                                 | _“div”_ 
                                 | _“mod”_ 
                                 | _“shi”_ 
                                 | _“shr”_ ) _“(”_ ⟨parameter_list⟩ _“)”_ ; 
 ⟨comparison_operator_definition⟩ = ( _“=”_ 
                                 | _“¡”_ 
                                 | _“¡=”_ 
                                 | _“¿”_ 
                                 | _“¿=”_ 
                                 | _“¡¿”_ 
                                 | _“in”_ ) _“(”_ ⟨parameter_list⟩ _“)”_ ;
    ⟨logical_operator_definition⟩ = ( _“and”_ | _“or”_ | _“xor”_ | _“not”_ ) _“j”_ ⟨parameter_list⟩ _“)”_
      ⟨other_operator_definition⟩ = ( _“emrmerator”_ | _“inc”_ | _“dec”_ ) _“ (”_ ⟨parameter_tist⟩ “) 
                      ⟨label_def⟩ = ⟨decimal_int⟩ | ⟨identifier⟩ ;
                     ⟨identifier⟩ = ⟨letter⟩ | __“_”__ { ⟨letter⟩ | ⟨dec_digit⟩ | __“_”__ } ;
                     ⟨designator⟩ = ( ⟨identifier⟩ | ⟨string⟩ ) ⟨selector⟩ | ⟨subrange⟩ ;
                       ⟨selector⟩ = _“.”_ ⟨identifier⟩ 
                                 | _“[”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“,”_ ⟨expression⟩ _“]”_ 
                                 | _“^”_ 
                                 | ⟨actual_paramet_list⟩ 
                      ⟨qualifier⟩ = ⟨identifier⟩ [ _“.”_ ⟨identifier⟩ ] ;
                ⟨string_constant⟩ = ⟨character_string⟩ _“{PLUS}”_ ⟨character_string⟩ ;
               ⟨integer_constant⟩ = ⟨signed_integer⟩ | ⟨unsigned_integer⟩ ;

                    ⟨comment⟩ = _+“(*”+_ ⟨non_comment_characters⟩ _+“*)”+_

               ⟨binary_digit⟩ = _“0”_ | _“1”_ ;
                ⟨octal_digit⟩ = ⟨binary_digit⟩ | _“2”_ | _“3”_ | _“4”_ | _“5”_ | _“6”_ | _“7”_ ;

       ⟨octal_digit_sequence⟩ =       ⟨octal_digit⟩ { ( __“_”__| ⟨octal_digit⟩ ) } ;

 ⟨hexadecimal_digit_sequence⟩ = ⟨hexadecimal_digit⟩ { ( __“_”__| ⟨hexadecimal_digit⟩ ) } ;
           ⟨unsigned_integer⟩ = ⟨decimal_digit_sequence⟩

             ⟨signed_integer⟩ = ⟨sign⟩ ⟨unsigned_integer⟩ ;

[[PL012]]
=== About this document

This is the programmer’s manual for Free Pascal.

It describes some of the peculiarities of the \fpc compiler, and provides a glimpse of how the compiler generates its code, and how you can change the generated code. It will not, however, provide a detailed account of the inner workings of the compiler, nor will it describe how to use the compiler (described in the User's Guide). It also will not describe the inner workings of the Run-Time Library (RTL). The best way to learn about the way the RTL is implemented is from the sources themselves.

The things described here are useful when things need to be done that require greater flexibility than the standard Pascal language constructs (described in the Language Reference Guide).

Since the compiler is continuously under development, this document may get out of date. Wherever possible, the information in this manual will be updated. If you find something which isn't correct, or you think something is missing, feel free to contact me ^1^.
 
^1^ at michael@freepascal.org


[[PG014]]
=== 1 Compiler directives

==== 1.1 Introduction

FPC supports compiler directives in the source file: Basically the same
directives as in Turbo Pascal, Delphi and Mac OS pascal compilers.
Some are recognized for compatibility only, and have no effect.

A compiler directive is always specified as a comment using curly braces:

[source,pascal]
----
{$DIRECTIVE [value]}
----

The older __(* *)__ notation, or the C++ notation __//__ cannot be used
for directives.

The fact that a directive is specified as a comment means that it is not 
a pascal instruction. That in turn means that if a non-existing directive is
specified, the compiler does not give an error, it just gives a warning
about an invalid/unknown directive.

There is a distinction between local and global directives:

•	 Local directives take effect from the moment they are encountered till
they are changed by another directive or the same directive with a different
argument: they can be specified more than once in a source file.
•	 Global directives have an effect on all of the compiled code. They
can, in general, only be specified once per source file. It also means that
their effect ends when the current unit is compiled; the effect does not 
propagate to another unit.


Some directives can only take a boolean value, which means a '+' to switch them on,
or a '-' to switch them off. No space should be present between the boolean
switch and the + or - sign. These directives are also known as switches.
Many switches have a long form also. If they do, then the name of the
long form is given also. 

For long switches, the + or - character to switch the option on or off, 
may be replaced by the __ON__ or __OFF__ keywords. In that case, there
must be a space between the directive name and the __ON__/__OFF__.

Thus __{$I+}__ is equivalent to __{$IOCHECKS ON}__ or __{$IOCHECKS+}__ and
__{$C-}__ is equivalent to __{$ASSERTIONS OFF}__ or __{$ASSERTIONS-}__.

The long forms of the switches are the same as their Delphi
counterparts.

It is worth mentioning that when defaults are indicated, this means defaults
in the absence of a configuration file. The configuration files distributed
with FPC will change some of the defaults mentioned here.

[cols="2,2"]
|===

|<<D003, $ASMMODE : Assembler mode (Intel 80x86 only)>>

[[PG015]]
==== 1.2 Local directives

Local directives can occur more than once in a unit or program,
If they have a command line counterpart, the command line argument is
restored as the default for each compiled file. The local directives
influence the compiler's behavior from the moment they're encountered
until the moment another switch annihilates their behavior, or the end
of the current unit or program is reached.


[[D001]]
===== $A or $ALIGN : Align Data

The __{$ALIGN}__ directive can be used to select the data alignment 
strategy of the compiler for records. It takes a numerical argument
which can be 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32, specifying the alignment boundary 
in bytes. For these values, it has the same effect as the 
__{$PACKRECORDS}__ directive (see <<D062, Packrecords>>).

Thus, the following

[source,pascal]
----
{$ALIGN 8}
----

is equivalent to 

[source,pascal]
----
{$PACKRECORDS 8}
----


In MacPas mode, additionally it can have the following values:

•	 __MAC68K__ Specifies alignment following the m68K ABI.
•	 __POWER__ Specifies alignment following the PowerPC ABI.
•	 __POWERPC__ Specifies alignment following the PowerPC ABI.
•	 __RESET__ Resets the default alignment.
•	 __ON__ Same as specifying 4.
•	 __OFF__ Same as specifying 1.

These values are not available in the __{$PACKRECORDS}__ directive. 


[[D002]]
===== $A1, $A2,$A4 and $A8

These directives are the same as the __$PACKRECORDS__ directive 
(see <<D062, Packrecords>>), but they have the alignment specifier embedded in the
directive. Thus the following:

[source,pascal]
----
{$A8 }
----

is equivalent to 

[source,pascal]
----
{$PACKRECORDS 8}
----

Note that the special cases of __$PACKRECORDS__ cannot be expressed this
way.


[[D003]]
===== $ASMMODE : Assembler mode (Intel 80x86 only)

The __{$ASMMODE XXX}__ directive informs the compiler what kind of assembler
it can expect in an __asm__ block. The __XXX__ should be replaced by one
of the following:

•	__att__ -- Indicates that __asm__ blocks contain AT&T syntax assembler.
•	__intel__ -- Indicates that __asm__ blocks contain Intel syntax
assembler.
•	__default__ -- Tells the compiler to use the default assembler style as
specified on the command-line, or, if it was not specified on the
command-line, the default for the current platform. This can be used to reset
the value to the default if it was changed.

These switches are local, and retain their value to the end of the unit that
is compiled, unless they are replaced by another directive of the same type.
The command line switch that corresponds to this switch is __-R__.

The default assembler reader is the AT&T reader.


[[D004]]
===== $B or $BOOLEVAL : Complete boolean evaluation

By default, the compiler uses shortcut boolean evaluation, i.e., the evaluation
of a boolean expression is stopped once the result of the total
expression is known with certainty. The __{$B}__ switch can be used
to change this behavior: if its argument is __+__, then the
compiler will always evaluate all terms in the expression. If it is
__-__ (the default) then the compiler will only evaluate as many
terms as are necessary to determine the result of the complete expression.

So, in the following example, the function __Bofu__, which has a boolean
result, will never get called.

[source,pascal]
----
If False and Bofu then
  ...
----

A consequence of this is that any additional actions that are done by
__Bofu__ are not executed. If compiled with __{$B+}__, then
__BoFu__ will be called anyway.


[[D005]]
===== $C or $ASSERTIONS : Assertion support

The __{$ASSERTIONS}__ switch determines if assert statements are
compiled into the binary or not. If the switch is on, the statement

[source,pascal]
----
Assert(BooleanExpression,AssertMessage);
----

Will be compiled in the binary. If the __BooleanExpression__ evaluates to
__False__, the RTL will check if the __AssertErrorProc__ is set. If it
is set, it will be called with as parameters the __AssertMessage__
message, the name of the file, the LineNumber and the address. If it is not
set, a runtime error 227 is generated.

The __AssertErrorProc__ is defined as

[source,pascal]
----
Type
  TAssertErrorProc=procedure(Const msg,fname : String;
                             lineno,erroraddr : Longint);
Var
  AssertErrorProc = TAssertErrorProc;
----

This can be used mainly for debugging purposes. The __system__ unit sets the
__AssertErrorProc__ to a handler that displays a message on __stderr__
and simply exits with a run-time error 227. The __sysutils__ unit catches the 
run-time error 227 and raises an __EAssertionFailed__ exception.


[[D006]]
===== $BITPACKING : Enable bitsize packing

The __$BITPACKING__ directive tells the compiler whether
it should use bitpacking or not when it encounters the __packed__
keyword for a structured type. The possible values are __ON__ and
__OFF__. If __ON__, then the compiler will bitpack structures when it
encounters the __Packed__ keyword.

In the following example, the __TMyRecord__ record will be bitpacked:

[source,pascal]
----
{$BITPACKING ON}
Type
  TMyRecord = packed record
    B1,B2,B3,B4 : Boolean;
  end;
----


Note that:

•	 The __$BITPACKING__ directive is ignored in MacPas mode, where
packed records are always bitpacked.
•	 The __bitpacked__ keyword can always be used to force bitwise
packing, regardless of the value of the __$BITPACKING__ directive, and
regardless of the mode.


[[D007]]
===== $CALLING : Specify calling convention

The __{$CALLING}__ directive tells the compiler which calling 
convention should be used if none is specified:

[source,pascal]
----
{$CALLING REGISTER}
----

By default it is __REGISTER__. The following calling conventions exist:

•	 default
•	 register
•	 cdecl
•	 pascal
•	 safecall
•	 stdcall
•	 oldfpccall

For a more detailed explanation of calling conventions, see <<CallingConventions>>.
As a special case, __DEFAULT__ can be used, to restore the default calling
convention.

.icon:wpexplorer[size=3x]
****
The calling convention of a procedural type is also changed by this directive.
****


[[D008]]
===== $CHECKPOINTER : Check pointer values

The __{$CHECKPOINTER}__ directive turns heap pointer checking on (value
__ON__) or off (value __OFF__). If heap pointer checking is on and the
code is compiled with the __-gh__ (heaptrace) option on, then a check is
inserted when dereferencing a pointer. The check will verify that the
pointer contains a valid value, i.e. points to a location that is reachable
by the program: the stack or a location in the heap. If not, a run-time error
216 or 204 is raised.

If the code is compiled without __-gh__ switch, then this directive has no
effect. Note that this considerably slows down the code.

Note that this only works for pointers managed by FPC. If you receive
and use pointers from external libraries, the checks will fail.


[[D009]]
===== $CODEALIGN : Set the code alignment

This switch sets the code alignment. It takes an argument which specifies
the alignment for a particular kind of code generated by the compiler. 
The general form is

[source,pascal]
----
{$CODEALIGN PARAM=VALUE}
----

Where __PARAM__ is the parameter to tune, and __VAR__ value is a
numerical value specifying an alignment. __PARAM__ can be one of the
following strings:

__PROC__:: Set the alignment for procedure entry points.
__JUMP__:: Set the alignment for jump destination locations.
__LOOP__:: Set alignment for loops (for, while, repeat).
__CONSTMIN__:: Minimum alignment for constants (both typed and untyped).
__CONSTMAX__:: Maximum alignment for constants (both typed and untyped).
__VARMIN__:: Minimum alignment for static and global variables.
__VARMAX__:: Maximum alignment for static and global variables.
__LOCALMIN__:: Minimum alignment for local variables.
__LOCALMAX__:: Maximum alignment for local variables.
__RECORDMIN__:: Minimum alignment for record fields.
__RECORDMAX__:: Maximum alignment for record fields.

By default the size of a data structure determines the alignment:

•	 A __SmallInt__ will be aligned at 2 bytes.
•	 A __LongInt__ will be aligned at 4 bytes.
•	 A __Int64__ will be aligned at 8 bytes. 

With the above switches the minimum required alignment and a maximum 
used alignment can be specified. The maximum allowed alignment is only
meaningful if it is smaller than the natural size. i.e. setting the 
maximum alignment (e.g. VARMAX) to 4, the alignment is forced to
be at most 4 bytes: The __Int64__ will then also be aligned at 
4 bytes. The __SmallInt__ will still be aligned at 2 bytes.

These values can also be specified on the command line as

[source,pascal]
----
-OaPARAM=VALUE
----


[[D010]]
===== $COPERATORS : Allow C like operators

This boolean switch determines whether C like assignment operators 
are allowed. By default, these assignments are not allowed.
After the following statement:

[source,pascal]
----
{$COPERATORS ON}
----

The following operators are allowed:

[source,pascal]
----
Var
  I : Integer;

begin
  I:=1;
  I+=3; // Add 3 to I and assign the result to I;
  I-=2; // Subtract 2 from I and assign the result to I;
  I*=2; // Multiply I with 2 and assign the result to I;
  I/=2; // Divide I with 2 and assign the result to I;
end;  
----


[[D011]]
===== $DEFINE or $DEFINEC : Define a symbol

The directive

[source,pascal]
----
{$DEFINE name}
----

defines the symbol __name__. This symbol remains defined until the end of
the current module (i.e. unit or program), or until a __$UNDEF name__ directive is encountered.

If __name__ is already defined, this has no effect. __Name__ is case
insensitive.

The symbols that are defined in a unit, are not saved in the unit file,
so they are also not exported from a unit.

Under Mac Pascal mode, the __$DEFINEC__ directive is equivalent to the 
__$DEFINE__ directive and is provided for Mac Pascal compatibility.

__{$DEFINE}__ can also be used to define macros or compile-time constants:

[source,pascal]
----
{$DEFINE cdecl:=stdcall}
----

will redefine the standard modifier __cdecl__ as __stdcall__.

More information about macros and compile-time constants, can be found in
<<Macros>>

The __{$DEFINE}__ directive has a command-line equivalent, __-d__

[source,pascal]
----
-dNAME
----

will define the symbol __Name__. Using

[source,pascal]
----
-dcdecl:=stdcall
----

one can redefine the standard modifier __cdecl__ as __stdcall__
from the command-line.


[[D012]]
===== $ELSE : Switch conditional compilation

The __{$ELSE}__ switches between compiling and ignoring the source
text delimited by the preceding __{$IFxxx}__ and following
__{$ENDIF}__. Any text after the __ELSE__ keyword but before the
brace is ignored:

[source,pascal]
----
{$ELSE some ignored text}
----

is the same as

[source,pascal]
----
{$ELSE}
----

This is useful for indication what switch is meant.


[[D013]]
===== $ELSEC : Switch conditional compilation

In MacPas mode, this directive can be used as an alternative to the __$ELSE__
directive. It is supported for compatibility with existing Mac OS pascal
compilers.


[[D014]]
===== $ELSEIF or $ELIFC : Switch conditional compilation

This directive can be used as a shortcut for a new
__{$IF}__ directive inside an __{$ELSE}__ clause:

[source,pascal]
----
{$IF XXX}
  // XXX Code here
{$ELSEIF YYY}
  // YYY code here
{$ELSE}
  // And default code here
{$ENDIF}
----

is equivalent to

[source,pascal]
----
{$IF XXX}
  // XXX Code here
{$ELSE }
{$IF YYY}
  // YYY code here
{$ELSE}
  // And default code here
{$ENDIF}
{$ENDIF}
----

The directive is followed by an expression like the ones recognized by the 
__{$IF}__ directive.

The __{$ELIFC}__ variant is allowed only in MacPas mode.


[[D015]]
===== $ENDC : End conditional compilation

In MacPas mode, this directive can be used as an alternative to the
__$ENDIF__ directive. It is supported for compatibility with existing 
Mac OS pascal compilers.


[[D016]]
===== $ENDIF : End conditional compilation

The __{$ENDIF}__ directive ends the conditional compilation initiated by the
last __{$IFxxx}__ directive. Any text after the __ENDIF__ keyword but
before the closing brace is ignored:

[source,pascal]
----
{$ENDIF some ignored text}
----

is the same as

[source,pascal]
----
{$ENDIF}
----

This is useful for indication what switch is meant to be ended.


[[D017]]
===== $ERROR or $ERRORC : Generate error message

The following code

[source,pascal]
----
{$ERROR This code is erroneous !}
----

will display an error message when the compiler encounters it,
and increase the error count of the compiler.
The compiler will continue to compile, but no code will be emitted.

The __$ERRORC__ variant is supplied for Mac Pascal compatibility.


[[D018]]
===== $ENDREGION: End of a collapsible region

This directive is parsed for Delphi compatibility but otherwise ignored. 
In Delphi, it marks the end of a collapsible region in the IDE.


[[D019]]
===== $EXCESSPRECISION: use excess precision with float

This directive tells the compiler to use maximum precision when evaluating
floating point expression, i.e. use the maximum possible precision, even if
the members in the calculation have less than maximum precision. 
It accepts a boolean value (__ON__/__OFF__ or +/-). 


[[D020]]
===== $EXTENDEDSYM: Ignored

This directive is parsed for Delphi compatibility but otherwise ignored. A
warning will be displayed when this directive is encountered.


[[D021]]
===== $EXTERNALSYM: Ignored

This directive is parsed for Delphi compatibility but otherwise ignored. 


[[D022]]
===== $F : Far or near functions

This directive is recognized for compatibility with Turbo Pascal. Under the
32-bit and 64-bit programming models, the concept of near and far calls have
no meaning, hence the directive is ignored. A warning is printed to the screen, 
as a reminder.

As an example, the following piece of code:

[source,pascal]
----
{$F+}

Procedure TestProc;

begin
 Writeln ('Hello From TestProc');
end;

begin
 testProc
end.
----

Generates the following compiler output:

[source,pascal]
----
malpertuus: >pp -vw testf
Compiler: ppc386
Units are searched in: /home/michael;/usr/bin/;/usr/lib/ppc/0.9.1/linuxunits
Target OS: Linux
Compiling testf.pp
testf.pp(1) Warning: illegal compiler switch
7739 kB free
Calling assembler...
Assembled...
Calling linker...
12 lines compiled,
 1.00000000000000E+0000
----

One can see that the verbosity level was set to display warnings.

When declaring a function as __Far__ (this has the same effect as setting it
between __{$F-}__ directives), the compiler also generates a warning:

[source,pascal]
----
testf.pp(3) Warning: FAR ignored
----


The same story is true for procedures declared as __Near__. The warning
displayed in that case is:

[source,pascal]
----
testf.pp(3) Warning: NEAR ignored
----


[[D023]]
===== $FATAL : Generate fatal error message

The following code

[source,pascal]
----
{$FATAL This code is erroneous !}
----

will display an error message when the compiler encounters it,
and the compiler will immediately stop the compilation process.

This is mainly useful in conjunction with __{$IFDEF}__ or
__{$IFOPT}__ statements.


[[D024]]
===== $FPUTYPE : Select coprocessor type

This directive selects the type of coprocessor used to do floating point
calculations. The directive must be followed by the type of floating point
unit. The allowed values depend on the target CPU:


all:: __SOFT__: FPC emulates the coprocessor (not yet implemented).
i386:: __X87__, __SSE__, __SSE2__: code compiled with __SSE__ 
uses the sse to do calculations involving a float of type __Single__.
This code runs only on Pentium III and above, or AthlonXP and above.
Code compiled with __SSE2__ uses the __sse__ unit to do calculations 
with the single and double data type. This code runs only on PentiumIV 
and above or Athlon64 and above 
x86-64:: __SSE64__ 
powerpc:: __STANDARD__ 
arm:: __LIBGCC__, __FPA__, __FPA10__, __FPA11__,__VFP__.
 

This directive corresponds to the __-Cf__ command line option.


[[D025]]
===== $GOTO : Support Goto and Label

If __{$GOTO ON}__ is specified, the compiler will support __Goto__
statements and __Label__ declarations. By default, __$GOTO OFF__ is
assumed. This directive corresponds to the __-Sg__ command line option.

As an example, the following code can be compiled:

[source,pascal]
----
{$GOTO ON}

label Theend;

begin
  If ParamCount=0 then
    GoTo TheEnd;
  Writeln ('You specified command line options');
TheEnd:
end.
----


.icon:wpexplorer[size=3x]
****
When compiling assembler code using the inline assembler
readers, any labels used in the assembler code must be declared, and 
the __{$GOTO ON}__ directive should be used.
****


[[D026]]
===== $H or $LONGSTRINGS : Use AnsiStrings

If __{$LONGSTRINGS ON}__ is specified, the keyword __String__ (no
length specifier) will be treated as __AnsiString__, and the compiler
will treat the corresponding variable as an ansistring, and will
generate corresponding code. This switch corresponds to the __-Sh__
command line option.

By default, the use of ansistrings is off, corresponding to __{$H-}__.
The __system__ unit is compiled without ansistrings, all its functions accept
shortstring arguments. The same is true for all RTL units, except the
__sysutils__ unit, which is compiled with ansistrings.

However, the __{$MODE}__ statement influences the default value of
__{$H}__: a __{$MODE DELPHI}__ directive implies a
__{$H+}__ statement, all other modes switch it off. As a result,
you should always put __{$H+}__ after a mode directive. 
This behavior has changed, in older FPC versions this was not so. 


[[D027]]
===== $HINT : Generate hint message

If the generation of hints is turned on, through the __-vh__ command line
option or the __{$HINTS ON}__ directive, then

[source,pascal]
----
{$Hint This code should be optimized }
----

will display a hint message when the compiler encounters it.

By default, no hints are generated.


[[D028]]
===== $HINTS : Emit hints

__{$HINTS ON}__ switches the generation of hints on.
__{$HINTS OFF}__ switches the generation of hints off.
Contrary to the command line option __-vh__ this is a local switch,
this is useful for checking parts of the code.


[[D029]]
===== $HPPEMIT: Ignored

This directive is parsed for Delphi compatibility but otherwise ignored.


[[D030]]
===== $IF : Start conditional compilation

The directive __{$IF expr}__ will continue the compilation
if the boolean expression __expr__ evaluates to __True__. If the
compilation evaluates to __False__, then the source is skipped to the first
__{$ELSE}__ or __{$ENDIF}__ directive.

The compiler must be able to evaluate the expression at parse time.
This means that variables or constants that are defined in
the source cannot be used. Macros and symbols may be used, however.

More information on this can be found in the section about
conditionals, <<compileexpressions>> on page 309.


[[D031]]
===== $IFC : Start conditional compilation

In MacPas mode, this directive can be used as an alternative to the __$IF__
directive. It is supported for compatibility with existing Mac OS pascal
compilers.


[[D032]]
===== $IFDEF Name : Start conditional compilation

If the symbol __Name__ is not defined then the __{$IFDEF name}__
will skip the compilation of the text that follows it to the first
__{$ELSE}__ or __{$ENDIF}__ directive.
If __Name__ is defined, then compilation continues as if the directive
wasn't there.

The __$IFDEF__ directive will only check the first word of what follows,
all the rest is ignored. This means that code after a

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFDEF RED}
----

and

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFDEF RED check that red is defined}
----

and

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFDEF RED or Blue}
----

will only be parsed if __RED__ is defined. The other words are ignored. In
particular, the existence of __BLUE__ will not be checked for the last case. 
If you need to check multiple values, you should use the __{$IF}__ construct instead.


[[D033]]
===== $IFEND : End conditional compilation

This directive can be used as an alternative to the __$ENDIF__ directive. 


[[D034]]
===== $IFNDEF : Start conditional compilation

If the symbol __Name__ is defined then the __{$IFNDEF name}__
will skip the compilation of the text that follows it to the first
__{$ELSE}__ or __{$ENDIF}__ directive.
If it is not defined, then compilation continues as if the directive
wasn't there.

Similar to __$IFDEF__, the  __$IFNDEF__ directive will only check the first 
word of what follows, all the rest is ignored. This means that code after a

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFNDEF RED}
----

and

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFNDEF RED check that red is defined}
----

and

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFNDEF RED or Blue}
----

will only be parsed if __RED__ is undefined. The other words are ignored. In
particular, the existence of __BLUE__ will not be checked for the last case. 
If you need to check multiple values, you should use the __{$IF}__ construct instead.


[[D035]]
===== $IFOPT : Start conditional compilation

The __{$IFOPT switch}__ will compile the text that follows it if the
switch __switch__ is currently in the specified state.
If it isn't in the specified state, then compilation continues after the
corresponding __{$ELSE}__ or __{$ENDIF}__ directive.

As an example:

[source,pascal]
----
{$IFOPT M+}
  Writeln ('Compiled with type information');
{$ENDIF}
----
